title: Logo upload hotfix, delete a draft
changes: HOTFIX: choosing a company logo with the real file dialog made the console throw an error while redrawing, so no button of that step worked afterwards (a prospect could not get past step 4). Fixed; the redraw never touches a file box now
Your games: an unpublished draft has a Delete (two taps). The 10-draft limit can no longer trap anyone, and the message says how to free a place
A note such as Draft deleted no longer follows the person into the next game

title: Step 4 never blocks a person
changes: A prospect could not get past step 4: a logo without a company name was refused and the reason was shown at the top of the step. Now the game is always saved: a name without a colour gets the first colour; a logo or colour without a name is simply not used yet, with a calm note
Any reason a Save is refused is also shown right above the Save button, in a red box

title: Sign-in tries, big-game claims, waiting-room words
changes: Sign-in code tries are counted before the code is compared, so wrong codes sent all at once still stop at five
In big games a full page of claims is no longer followed by a later Bogey: phones cannot skip claims
The waiting room says the common link, a personal link or the game link instead of internal codes
One network address may now open 600 new places a minute and 20,000 a day (was 200 and 1,500): a whole office shares one address, so a crowd joining together is no longer turned away

title: Review fixes: Host AI key, cash edit, people list
changes: Security: the 24-hour Host AI-link key can no longer finish a Host setup and turn itself into a lasting Host key
Editing the amount or currency of a saved cash prize is now saved
Step 6 shows one Play the game yourself block (the second copy had dead buttons and duplicate ids)
My people list loads every page even when removed rows exist
Smart Placement switched on: the Function runs next to the database, so a join (about 26 database calls) is no longer slowed by a far-away edge

title: Employees-only and ID check kept on re-save
changes: Console: after a reload the form shows the saved employees-only, employee-ID check and tie rule, so saving step 2 or 3 no longer wipes them (found by the code review; regression test added)

title: Second browser and kept typing
changes: The organizer signed in on a second browser or phone can add that browser's own signing key, so Next number and Pause work there
Unsaved typing and ticks in the console survive the page refreshing itself; pressing a button starts from the saved state

title: Game day line, owner-only version history
changes: Game day step: a line says the Organizer / Host logs into the game and controls it
Owner-only version history page and release list (not visible to the public)

title: First market-ready release
changes: Cash prize option with currency chips (INR default) and amount
Notice under video and audio links: we do not save them, we play them from the link
Staff-list consent box hidden and sent automatically; clause 11.4A in the Terms
Professional data-handling text in step 10
AI welcome e-mail switched off at sign-up
Daily write guard raised for the paid Cloudflare plan

title: Manual games in every browser
changes: The organizer control key now works in browsers without WebCrypto Ed25519 (pure-JS fallback), so Host-mode games run on the Host's own schedule in Safari-type browsers

title: Six-sigma test programme fixes
changes: Employees-only and employee-ID settings are no longer lost when a later step is saved
Organizer e-mail at the top right, help text for who the game is for
Click-only live tests on corporatetambola.com in Chrome, Chromium and WebKit

title: Verify and employee-ID release
changes: Employee ID and mobile verification options
All-products test and go-live audit

title: Guided errors
changes: Every mistake gets a polite explanation, exact steps and a button to the right place
Public promises corrected (brochure prices, partner repeat rate, Razorpay address)

title: Payment testing and Corporate Games bar
changes: Payment Testing page (real Rs 1 / US$ 1 payment that buys nothing)
Corporate Games bar on every public page

title: Simpler step 2 and people lists
changes: No prices in step 2, own number of players, clearer wording
People lists, personal and common links, waiting room

title: Data deletion and brand moments
changes: Participant data crypto-shredded at 23 hours, report link closes at 22 hours
Brand moments: opening, three during, closing

title: AI work link and privacy links
changes: Short AI work link
Privacy Policy link on the join page

title: First build
changes: Game engine, organizer console, payments on the Worker (Razorpay), GST invoices
